label: Closed grounding collections rooted, from no wholly borrowed collection (inference)
rule: A ground-closed rootless collection is, by the bridge, closed under every actual supplier, and each member has one; the borrowed-reality principle makes it empty
meaning: Borrowed reality implies CCR under the sufficient supplier-concreteness bridge. Borrowed reality alone does not imply CCR, as abstractSupplier demonstrates. Blanket supplier concreteness is not necessary; the sibling batch supplies the localized root-access alternative. Constructive; conditional consequence only.
